claims.text: Qatar's prime minister is scheduled to travel to Tehran to restart diplomatic negotiations between Iran and the United States.
Ship-tracking data showed that about 5 million barrels of oil per day passed through the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, compared to roughly 20 million barrels per day before February 28.
The UN's International Maritime Organization recorded 70 incidents in the Strait of Hormuz since February 28, resulting in the deaths of 19 seafarers.
Iran's Revolutionary Guards stated that Tehran and Oman agreed on arrangements for sharing the Strait of Hormuz and its revenues.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated that he doubted negotiations could produce an agreement with Iran's current leadership.
Iranian and Omani foreign ministers discussed a framework agreement in Tehran to establish a temporary shipping corridor and clear mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi stated that the Strait of Hormuz will only reopen in exchange for an end to the war, lifting the blockade, and resolving the situation in Yemen.
US President Donald Trump stated that the war with Iran will continue for as long as necessary.
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian stated that the war must end at some point while Iran still negotiates from a position of strength.
Ship tracker Kpler reported that only 112 oil and gas tankers passed through the Strait of Hormuz between August 1 and August 19.
US President Donald Trump stated in an interview that it was time to teach Canada that they cannot continue their actions.
The United States imposed new 50 percent tariffs on $20 billion worth of Canadian imports after trade negotiations collapsed.
Canada announced retaliatory tariffs matching US duties on about $20 billion worth of annual US imports taking effect on September 8.
Donald Trump announced 50 percent tariffs on Canadian autos and parts scheduled to take effect on January 1.
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney stated that Canada had been attacked and announced retaliatory tariffs on US steel, dairy products, appliances, and farm equipment.
US Vice President JD Vance claimed at a rally in Maine that Canada and China are the two worst countries regarding trade policy.
Canada announced retaliatory tariffs ranging from 15% to 50% on approximately $20 billion worth of American goods.
Canadian Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne stated that Canada will match US tariffs dollar for dollar starting September 8.
In a leaked audio recording, US Vice President JD Vance described Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney as a very sweet guy who tries to out-tough Donald Trump.
Annual bilateral trade between the United States and Canada totals more than $872 billion.
A fire in the mother and child unit at Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences in Islamabad killed 14 newborn infants.
PIMS Executive Director Rana Imran Sikander stated that the maternity ward door was manned rather than locked to prevent baby theft.
Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif suspended Federal Health Secretary Aslam Ghauri following the hospital fire.
Rescue officials reported that the hospital fire began around 6:45 a.m. after an air-conditioning unit compressor exploded inside the nursery.
Federal Health Minister Mustafa Kamal confirmed that at least 14 babies died in the fire at PIMS.
Hospital spokesperson Dr. Aneeza Jalil stated that 15 babies were in the ward when the fire broke out and one baby was saved by a doctor.
Health Minister Mustafa Kamal stated that oxygen canisters in the ward intensified the hospital fire.
Meta agreed to pay up to $17.1 billion in a settlement with US states over child safety.
Meta agreed to pay $17 billion to settle claims filed by 47 US states over social media addiction and harm to teenagers.
Under the settlement with US states, Meta agreed to implement a hard cap on daily time limits and daytime school hour notification pauses on Instagram and Facebook.
Meta proposed a 2-hour daily usage cap across its platforms for users under the age of 18 as part of the proposed settlement.
Meta stated that 30% of its settlement payment is conditional on YouTube and TikTok implementing matching daily limits and safety features.
Meta agreed to a $16.68 billion settlement with 29 US states over child data collection and teen addiction claims.
In a previous lawsuit filed by New Mexico, Meta was ordered to pay $375 million by a jury in March and $567 million by a judge on August 6.
The Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces officially announced its dissolution after merging with the Syrian national army.
The Syrian Democratic Forces was founded in 2015 and controlled large areas of northern Syria before merging with the state military.
The Syrian Kurdish forces announced their official dissolution on August 25, 2026.
SDF leader Mazloum Abdi announced the dissolution of the group during an address at the presidential palace in Damascus.
Under the agreement, SDF military fighters integrate into the Syrian army under the Defence Ministry, while Asayish security forces join the Interior Ministry.
SDF official Abdulkarim Omar stated that the Women's Protection Units proposed joining the Interior Ministry as a specialized counterterrorism unit.
The Turkish government stated that the dissolution of the SDF is crucial for strengthening Syrian state authority and stability.
